verdict.rationale: Fern's docs state it generates API Reference documentation from an OpenAPI specification. Its CLI validates API definitions, previews changes locally with hot reload, and publishes docs, so regenerating after a spec change is part of the documented workflow. A community review corroborates that Fern covers docs alongside SDKs and can merge multiple specs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic resync when the spec changes (e.g., CI/GitHub-triggered regeneration), in-depth docs on OpenAPI-to-reference mapping, and independent hands-on confirmation of sync behavior.
